card.name: Just before intubation or stent words
card.fires_on: Fires on the word or word start right before a predicted word beginning with "int" or "st/fl" pieces, such as 'coronary st|ents' and 'INCLUDING' before INTUBATION. It also fires on 'WAS' or 'NOT' before INTUBATED.

modes.label: Before intubation
modes.description: Small linking words in all-caps text right before INTUBATION or INTUBATED.
modes.example: AIRWAY MANAGEMENT,<< INCLUDING>> INTUBATION, SHOULD ALSO BE ADMIN

modes.label: Coronary stent split
modes.description: The 'st' piece inside the word stenting or stents after coronary.
modes.example: this combination of vitamins should not be recommended for patients receiving coronary<< st>>ents.

modes.label: Flake and stare starts
modes.description: Word starts like 'fl' or 'St' in non-medical text, such as flake tools or stared.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing words that begin with "int", such as intubated.
card.plain: It lights up on the spot just before a word like intubation is expected, and on a few word starts like stents.
